assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET for an isometric Smurfs woodland village desktop app. Classic hand-drawn Smurfs cartoon appearance, charming clean dark blue ink outlines, soft cel shading, bright blue skin, expressive eyes, a consistent slightly elevated three-quarter front view facing slightly right. True transparent alpha background. Landscape 1536x1024, exact regular grid 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 512x512 cells. Each cell contains ONE complete full-body pose of THE SAME character. Center each pose, feet on same baseline 450px within its cell, same character scale around 365px high, generous empty margins, no cropping, no overlapping cells. No labels, text, frame borders, scenery, floor, or ground shadows. Top row left to right: neutral happy standing with hands relaxed; walking with left foot forward and opposite arm forward; complementary walking with right foot forward and opposite arm forward. Bottom row left to right: working action A described below; slightly changed working action B for a two-frame loop; celebrating with a friendly raised-hand wave. Make the walking poses visibly different and keep the face, outfit and body proportions consistent. Character: PAPA SMURF, elderly blue male Smurf with fluffy white beard and eyebrows, red Phrygian cap, red pants and red shoes, bare blue chest. Work A: holds a small glass potion flask in one hand and gestures thoughtfully with the other; work B: carefully examines the raised flask. The flask is tiny, with turquoise liquid. All six poses must unmistakably be Papa Smurf.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production scenery atlas for a classic Smurfs isometric woodland village game. Charming hand-inked cartoon outlines and soft painted cel shading, cheerful storybook colors, toy-sized mushroom village in a forest. Consistent elevated isometric view with 2:1 ground axes, front faces toward the viewer and lower right, light from upper left. True transparent alpha background. Landscape 1536x1024, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal cells 384x512. ONE separate complete object per cell, generous 28px transparent margins, no objects touching or crossing cell boundaries. No characters, no text, no labels, no cell borders, no surrounding scene, no ground slab or cast shadows. Objects centered with their foot at 465px within each cell. Create eight different SMURF MUSHROOM HOUSES. Round creamy plaster walls, quaint curved wooden doors and little windows, actual thick mushroom cap roofs, cozy and distinctly Smurfs. Top row left to right: 1 Papa Smurf's larger home, rich red spotted mushroom cap, round blue windows, little stone chimney on upper left, a tiny potion flask beside door; 2 Smurfette's home, pink cap, flower boxes and rose vines around round door; 3 Brainy's home/library, sky blue spotted cap, a book emblem over the door and books beside the entrance; 4 Jokey's home, sunny yellow cap, a closed yellow gift with red ribbon beside the door. Bottom row left to right: 1 Hefty's home, orange cap, sturdy round door, little stone dumbbells by the entrance; 2 ordinary Smurf home, classic scarlet cap with white spots, simple blue door, little chimney upper left; 3 village bakery mushroom house, honey-yellow cap, stone chimney upper left, bread baskets and an oven window; 4 Handy's workshop mushroom house, green cap, small wooden awning with tools, a wooden gear beside the door. Maintain eight visually distinct separated buildings.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four seamless-material isometric ground tiles for a classic Smurfs cartoon woodland village game. Hand-painted clean colorful storybook texture, softly shaded, gently inked details. True transparent background. Square 1024x1024 exact 2x2 grid of four 512x512 cells. In EACH cell, one perfectly flat isometric DIAMOND ground tile 440 pixels wide and 220 pixels high, centered at the cell center. The diamond is a simple 2:1 rhombus with sharp matching edges, no raised sides, no thickness, no border frame, no cast shadow. Transparent outside each diamond. Tiles fully fill their diamond silhouette, smoothly colored all the way to each edge so repeated tiles form continuous terrain. TOP LEFT: lush soft green meadow grass, tiny understated blades. TOP RIGHT: warm sandy golden woodland footpath, light sparse flecks, no grass edge. BOTTOM LEFT: quaint rounded pale beige cobblestones tightly packed, no grass edge. BOTTOM RIGHT: clear turquoise gently flowing stream water with subtle blue ripples and highlights, no banks or rocks. No objects, characters, plants, labels, letters, gutters or frames. Exactly four separated diamond tiles.

assets.edit: Edit target: the attached eight-object village workplaces sprite atlas. Change ONLY the background: completely remove the off-white backdrop and every background glow/halo, making every pixel outside the actual object silhouettes genuinely fully transparent (alpha zero). Preserve the exact eight illustrated objects, their outlines, colors, positions, sizes and the 4-column 2-row layout. Keep the objects themselves fully opaque. No shadows or cloudy semi-transparent rectangles behind them. Do not add any objects, labels, text or scenery. This is a production transparent sprite atlas, not a white-background illustration.

rendering: PNG bytes are retained unchanged. Atlas rectangles and alpha trimming are applied at render time.
